question.problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)=6xy$ on the region $D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2{y}^{2},\,0\le y\le 1\}$ given that the area of the region is $\frac{2}{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{ave}} & =\frac{1}{\text{Area}(D)}\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{(\frac{2}{3})}{∬}_{D}6xy\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{3}{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2{y}^{2}}6xy\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}[3{x}^{2}y]_{x=0}^{x=2{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}12{y}^{5}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{2}[2{y}^{6}]_{y=0}^{y=1} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}(2-0) \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
